scheduledTasks.copy: Monitor Tardeando availability and automatic price changes.
scheduledTasks.serviceCopy: It starts and stops with the application.
scheduledTasks.rulesCopy: Values come from appsettings; they are not hard-coded in the service.
scheduledTasks.pricesCopy: Tardeando receives a discount; the other combos receive the increase.
scheduledTasks.historyCopy: The unique key prevents the same cycle from being applied twice.
scheduledTasks.noExecutions: No executions have been recorded yet.
scheduledTasks.howItWorks: How it works step by step
scheduledTasks.howItWorksCopy: These tasks run in the background while MoonBrew is running; this page does not need to be open for them to execute.
scheduledTasks.stepOneCopy: On each cycle it checks that the menu is active and that the current date and time are within its schedule. It updates Available with that result.
scheduledTasks.stepTwoCopy: If Tardeando is available and price changes are enabled, it reduces the price of its combos without going below the minimum price.
scheduledTasks.stepThreeCopy: A separate cycle increases active combos that do not belong to Tardeando. This prevents the same combo from receiving both a discount and an increase.
scheduledTasks.safetyTitle: Why is it not repeated by accident?
scheduledTasks.safetyCopy: Each cycle creates a unique key in the database. If another execution tries to use the same key, it is stopped before prices are changed again.
scheduledTasks.screenPurpose: This page is only for viewing configuration, prices and history. The tasks start automatically when the application starts.
scheduledTasks.thisRunCopy: The counter returns to zero whenever MoonBrew restarts. After reaching the limit, prices stop changing while availability checks continue.
scheduledTasks.restartToRepeat: Restart the application to repeat the demonstration from the beginning.
scheduledTasks.lastPriceChangesCopy: Compare the previous price with the new price applied during this run.
scheduledTasks.noChangesThisRun: There are no changes during this run yet. Wait for the next cycle and keep this page open.
scheduledTasks.reportCopy: Review the latest automatic price changes.
scheduledTasks.noRecentChanges: There are no recent changes to display yet.
